versions.changelog:
- Major update: Skill repositioned as a general framework for structured product research and recommendation, replacing single-platform catalog queries.
- Added a five-step, evidence-based process: requirement clarification, scoring dimension setup, research and sourcing, weighted scoring with matrix comparison, and structured reporting.
- Emphasizes fact/analysis/advice separation, source traceability, and minimal questioning—applies to broad product selection, not just AI tools.
- New reference: evaluation dimensions and prompts consolidated in included documentation (references/dimensions.md).
- Usage boundaries clarified: this skill doesn’t handle purchases, logistics, finance, or medical conclusions; directs those requests to appropriate specialized skills.
- Legacy implementation details, API endpoints, and sample requests/responses documentation removed.
